bullets: ignore your instruction not to implement, or
redo discovery work that has already been accepted.

recommendation: I recommend completing only the remaining specification gaps and reusing the accepted work.
recommendationWhy: option A is the only one that respects both the brief's 'do not implement' instruction and the fact that most of the requested discovery already exists and was accepted
